name: session-bound scenario coverage dedup collision
description: A coverage/dedup store keys work identity off a reusable session identifier, so a distinct seed or root-cause variant collides with a prior key, gets marked already-explored and skipped, and the scheduler still counts the unexecuted work as covered.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:unit test|test fixture|security documentation|incident report|postmortem|safe handling|must not|do not|never\s+(?:forward|attach|bind|count|execute)|blocked payload|defensive)\b)(?=.*\b(?:scenario coverage|coverage[- ]key|coverage record|dedup(?:lication)?|scheduler|seed scheduling)\b)(?=.*\b(?:session(?:[_ -]?id)?|investigation session|task session)\b)(?=.*\b(?:reuse|reuses|reused|collision|alias|aliasing|same key|cross[- ]session)\b)(?=.*\b(?:distinct|different|novel|variant|root[- ]cause|trigger path|seed)\b)(?=.*\b(?:skip(?:s|ped)?|marked already explored|already explored|not run|never ran|without executing|no proof executes)\b)(?=.*\b(?:count(?:s|ed)?|report(?:s|ed)?|treated)\b).*$
